values.FULL_COVER_LETTER:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I have spent the last several years building products that people rely on every day, and this role is the work I want to do next.

In my most recent position I took over a release process that regularly slipped by weeks. I found where the delays came from, rewrote the checklist around those findings, and within two quarters we shipped on the planned date.

I would be glad to bring that same care to your team.

Sincerely,
values.COVER_LETTER_BODY:

values.COMPANY_APPEAL: What draws me to your company is the care the job description puts into steady improvement and close work with the people who use the product. That is the way I like to work.
values.ROLE_FIT: The role asks for someone who can bring order to complex work, and that has been the thread through my recent positions. I have taken projects that kept slipping and turned them into plans people could rely on.
values.CANDIDATE_STRENGTHS: My strengths are clear writing, patient problem solving and following through. Colleagues come to me when something is unclear, because I write things down and see them to the end.
values.SKILL_HIGHLIGHT: When a release process at my last company kept slipping by weeks, I traced the delays to their real causes and rebuilt the checklist around them. Within two quarters we were shipping on the planned date.
